scene.description: Close on a single cream cut-paper browser-window card, its raised chrome address strip and its recessed content panel both glowing softly as two distinct physical layers, a small navy paper hinge pinning the two layers together at one edge.
scene.one_idea: two disciplines as two physical layers of one page

objects.state: the raised chrome address strip and the recessed content panel both glowing softly as two visibly separate layers
objects.prop_definition: rounded rectangle of card stock, raised raised top strip cut from warm grey card, matte paper, never metal or gloss with slotted address bar and punched dots, recessed content panel, both treated as distinct layers

objects.state: pinning the raised top strip cut from warm grey card, matte paper, never metal or gloss layer to the content panel layer at one edge

lighting.key: soft warm key light, upper left, 3000K to 3500K, roughly 40 degrees, large diffuser, soft gradual shadow edges
lighting.fill: weak cool fill from the right, about one quarter key strength
lighting.practical: single internal practical spread evenly across both layers of the card, glowing at #FDE7C8

camera.setup: B: straight-on macro, level or a few degrees above, close enough that the two layers and the hinge are legible
camera.orientation: near-parallel to the card face with a slight rotation so the layer separation reads
camera.framing: approximately 30 to 40 degree field of view, close, layering and paper fibre legible

background.falloff: darker toward the top of the frame

composition_rules.focal_position: off centre, roughly on a third
composition_rules.physical_plausibility: every object must be able to stand, lean or lie as shown
composition_rules.one_focal_group: exactly one warm-lit focal group with a single light source: the card's two glowing layers
composition_rules.navy_group_rule: the navy element is one object, or repetitions of one identical object in one contiguous composition; never mixed navy objects
composition_rules.navy_range: subdued navy paper only, #1A2340 to #3F4A68; no vivid, emitted or periwinkle blue

negative: Google or browser or search-engine marks
more than one warm light source
more than one navy element group
